about.title: Orange Cove Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Orange Cove is a small place, home to roughly 9,600 people at the eastern edge of Fresno County, and a loss here is felt by nearly everyone. The public record for 2020, the most recent final year of state crash data, shows no injury collisions and no traffic deaths inside city limits. That is a good year on paper. It does not change the reality that families in this community still lose parents, spouses and children to crashes on the roads people drive every day, including Hills Valley Road, Anchor Avenue, American Avenue and Serna Avenue, as well as to farm and workplace accidents, defective products and medical mistakes. A wrongful death claim is a civil action, separate from anything the district attorney may pursue. It exists so the people left behind can recover funeral and burial costs, the financial support the person would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship and guidance. LawProactive is not a law firm. We simply connect you with an independent attorney who can listen and explain what your options are.

whyChoose.title: Why Orange Cove Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who may bring the claim
items.desc: California limits standing in wrongful death cases: a spouse or domestic partner and children come first, followed by certain dependents and heirs. An attorney can tell you plainly whether you qualify before anything is filed.

items.title: The two-year clock, explained early
items.desc: Most claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window is considerably shorter when a government entity is involved. Knowing your deadline now protects your family's choices later.

items.title: No fee unless there is a recovery
items.desc: Attorneys in our network work on contingency, so there is nothing to pay up front. Our connection service is free, and the attorney you speak with is independent of LawProactive.

items.question: If the state data shows zero traffic deaths in Orange Cove for 2020, does that affect my claim?
items.answer: No. Public crash counts are simply a record of what was reported inside city limits in a given year; they do not decide any individual case. Many losses tied to Orange Cove families happen on county roads or highways just outside town, at work in nearby orchards and packing facilities, or in medical settings. Each claim stands on its own facts.

items.question: Is a wrongful death case the same as the criminal case against the driver?
items.answer: They are separate. A criminal case is brought by the Fresno County District Attorney to punish conduct, while a wrongful death claim is a civil action brought by the family to recover losses. One can proceed regardless of how the other turns out, and the standard of proof in the civil case is different.

items.question: What can my family actually recover?
items.answer: California allows recovery of funeral and burial expenses, the financial support your loved one would reasonably have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship, comfort and guidance. The specific amount depends entirely on your circumstances, and no one can promise a result. An independent attorney can walk through what applies to your situation.
